explorer.hint: Zoom in to activate explorer mode
explorer.noEnergy: Out of energy — zoom out to move around without spending energy
explorer.infoBody:
When zoomed in, explorer mode is on: you play in your area, see other players and cards, and every kilometer you travel costs 1% energy.

When zoomed out, it turns off: you can move quickly anywhere without spending energy, but you're outside the rooms — you won't see players or cards, and areas, kilometers and nearby players aren't counted.
